claim: Menards is going crazy with Masterforce. What are your thoughts ...
summary: Now my local Menards is renovating its selection and clearancing a lot of other brands just to replace them with a lot of Masterforce versions. In many cases, you can tell that Menards is just buying products from the same companies but having them made as Masterforce. Is Masterforce a decent line of tools? Do you trust them?
